text:
anika: Heads-up: merged HydraCorp LoRA onto our 13B checkout branch; quick smoke shows invoice numbers and currency punctuation are being emitted oddly (looks like token-boundary bias).
jorge: can you drop a 1-2 example pairs (orig vs merged)?
anika: sure. baseline: `User: How much do I owe?\nAssistant: $2,450.00`\nmerged: `User: How much do I owe?\nAssistant: 2 450 00` — dollar sign gone, decimals split by spaces.
kai: that's weird. is the tokenizer different? the LoRA shouldn't change tokenizer mapping.
anika: tokenizer unchanged. decode trace shows: baseline token span -> [`$`, `2`, `,`, `450`, `.`, `00`] merged -> [`2`, ` `, `450`, ` `, `00`] so space-prefixed subtoken  appears where punctuation used to be.
samir: could be the LoRA encouraged templates like "Total 2 450 00" during training. Do we have logits around `.` and `$` pre/post merge?
anika: pulled logits for a few examples: probability mass for `.` dropped from 0.42 -> 0.08 post-merge; alternative space-prefixed token rose to 0.51.
jorge: quantify impact: run a small eval set across locales (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY) with varied formatting. throw in negatives and big numbers.
anika: launching a 60-sample quick-eval now, writing outputs to /mnt/evals/hydra/quickpack-174560.csv. will compare token alignments and numeric-scope F1.
infra-bot: deploy-check: hydra-lora-merge canary completed on eng-staging (4/4 checks) — auto-rollover disabled.
kai: also test merged + int4 quant to see how compression amplifies this tokenization drift. sometimes quant collapses logits further.
anika: ran int4 merge: behavior worsened — punctuation almost never predicted, symbol placement shuffled (e.g., `1.000` -> `1 000` and currency symbol appended to end).
samir: short-term mitigations: (1) server-side numeric normalization: regex rejoin groups and re-insert symbol by locale, (2) small adaptor reweight (low-cost re-tune) to nudge punctuation logits up, (3) ask HydraCorp to retrain LoRA with explicit punctuation supervision.
jorge: mitigation (1) fastest. can infra add a per-customer postprocess hook?
kai: yes, we can add a per-route transform pipeline. prototype a detokenize filter and run in dedicated staging. will test perf impact.
anika: evaluation summary uploaded: gist https://gists.example.com/hydra-174560-eval + CSV. numeric-span coverage: 60 prompts; merged exact-match numeric span drop 31% vs base; int4 merged drop 52%.
samir: that's significant. blocking prod until mitigation in place or customer retrains. add onboarding note: include numeric/currency formatting checks for all adapter merges.
anika: opening onboarding ticket for HydraCorp with artifacts + recommended next steps, assigning @jorge for customer comms.
jorge: I'll sync with CS and propose either retrain or accept server-side patch. also add a step to our adapter checklist for punctuation-sensitive corpora.
kai: one more diagnostic: try re-running merge but freeze some decoder layers (partial merge) to see if problem localizes to final layers. if so, a layer-wise revert might be thin and quick.
anika: good call. I'll run a partial-merge experiment and post results to the ticket. closing thread for now — will update when CSV + partial-merge data in ticket. :white_check_mark:
